critical_low.hazard: High risk of microbial collapse, compaction, and desertification

moderate.hazard: Moderate water-holding capacity, nutrient leaching vulnerability

healthy.hazard: Optimal structural aggregation and mycorrhizal activity

high.hazard: High carbon sequestration, preserve against tillage oxidation
high.source: IPCC Special Report on Climate Change and Land (2019)

optimal.status: Peak nutrient bioavailability and microbial diversity

alkaline_calcareous.status: Micronutrient chlorosis (Fe, Zn deficiency), low microbial respiration

wilting_point.status: Severe moisture stress for vegetation and macrofauna

monoculture_wheat.description: Continuous single-species cereal cropping with bare fallow periods
monoculture_wheat.source: FAO State of the World's Biodiversity for Food and Agriculture (2019)

monoculture_corn_soy.description: Industrial row crops with intensive pesticide and synthetic nitrogen application

intercropping_cereal_legume.description: Simultaneous cultivation of cereal with nitrogen-fixing pulses/legumes
intercropping_cereal_legume.source: FAO Conservation Agriculture Guidelines; Lithourgidis et al. (2011)

agroforestry_alley_cropping.description: Multi-strata perennial woody hedgerows integrated with annual crops
agroforestry_alley_cropping.source: IPCC AR6 WGIII Ch. 7 Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Uses (AFOLU)

silvopasture.description: Deliberate integration of trees, forage legumes, and grazing livestock

native_forest_woodland.pollinator_support: Apex (native solitary bees, lepidoptera, syrphid flies)
native_forest_woodland.description: Multi-tiered native climax canopy and mycorrhizal fungal network

arid.vulnerability: Extreme drought risk, biological crust sensitivity
arid.key_intervention: Drought-resilient nitrogen-fixing shrubs (Acacia, Prosopis cineraria), micro-catchment water harvesting
arid.source: FAO Arid Zone Forestry; UNCCD Land Degradation Neutrality

semi-arid.vulnerability: Prone to desertification upon bare fallow tillage and heavy machinery compaction
semi-arid.key_intervention: Agroforestry windbreaks, legume cover crops (Vicia villosa), minimum tillage, organic mulching
semi-arid.source: IPCC AR6 WGII Land and Water Systems (2022)

sub_humid.vulnerability: Runoff erosion on slopes, nutrient leaching in coarse soils
sub_humid.key_intervention: Contour hedgerows, perennial grass strips, multi-species cover cropping

humid_tropical.vulnerability: Rapid organic matter oxidation, phosphorus fixation in oxisols/ultisols
humid_tropical.key_intervention: Multi-canopy shaded agroforestry (Cacao/Coffee + Inga edulis), biochar amendments

critical_depleted.evaluation: Severe monoculture depression; dominant single invasive/pest species

moderate.evaluation: Fragmented functional diversity with missing pollinator/predator guilds

high.evaluation: Resilient trophic web with balanced predator-prey and pollinator dynamics

depleted.impact: Pollination deficit in entomophilous crops (-20% yield gap)

viable.impact: High fruit set, genetic flow, and native wild bee sustenance
viable.source: IPBES Pollinators, Pollination and Food Production (2016)

high_hazard.effect: Non-target mortality of apifauna, soil nematode suppression, aquatic runoff toxicity

integrated_pest_mgmt.effect: Preserves parasitoid wasps and ground beetles as natural biocontrol agents
integrated_pest_mgmt.source: FAO Guidance on Pest and Pesticide Management

critical_isolation.effect: Severe genetic bottlenecks for flightless arthropods and small mammals
